title: The Pale Harvest
journal: Nesh-Deeka sent me to the wreck of the Pale Harvest in Hatandros Bight, a short swim out from Ysan's jetty. I need to get into the hold, where the drowned crew walk, and open the captain's strongbox. I may fight them, or steal past them and pick its lock, a hard one; the captain carries its key. The drowned attack whoever they see, so a quiet player who is seen has a fight on their hands.
objectives: Open the captain's strongbox in the wreck of the Pale Harvest. (marker: Captain's Strongbox, Drowned Captain, Ysan Jetty)

plan.going: The silver setting named the Pale Harvest, a wreck that may hold the next clue to the Eye. The hunt's aim: find the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea, before the Unbound do.
plan.next: Travel by boat to Thorn, walk to Ysan's jetty, swim to the wreck and open the captain's strongbox.
plan.ways: Fight the drowned crew and take the captain's key, or sneak past them and pick the strongbox's Adept lock.
terms: Hatandros Bight and Ysan: journal 10: the bay, and the landing with the stone jetty

answers: I work for Nesh-Deeka and the Toh-Reel-Ka. The Pale Harvest was a Company freighter that sank in Hatandros Bight with a Gideon dealer stock aboard, and it is tied to the glass Eye that Ennodius Vanin has hunted for twenty years.
Get into the wreck of the Pale Harvest, from Ysan jetty, and open the captain's strongbox in the hold.
Fight the drowned crew, or sneak past them and pick the hard lock; the Drowned Captain carries the key.
I do not know who Cuts-the-Old-Knot, Xeech-Leel or Umbriel are, or what seal paste is. I might learn by asking people or reading what is in the strongbox.

title: The Pale Harvest
journal: In the captain's strongbox lay a keystone on a chain, carved in a style I do not know. Nesh-Deeka will want to see it in Helstrom.
objectives: Bring the keystone to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. (marker: Nesh-Deeka)

plan.going: I have a keystone from the wreck; I do not know what it opens. The hunt's aim: find the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea, before the Unbound do.
plan.next: Bring it to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom, by boat back up the rivers.

answers: I killed the drowned sailor and captain in the Pale Harvest wreck, took the key and opened the strongbox. It held a Kothringi Keystone on a chain, carved in a style I do not know. It may be linked to the Eye hunt, but I do not know how.
Bring the keystone to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom.
I can go straight to her, or look at the keystone and ask others about it first. I see no other choice.

I do not know what a Kothringi Keystone is or what it opens. The Kothringi are a people I only vaguely know of. Nesh-Deeka might know. Cuts-the-Old-Knot, seal paste, Xeech-Leel and Umbriel are still unknown.

title: The Pale Harvest
journal: Nesh-Deeka did not know the keystone, but it is of Kothringi make (the Kothringi were the silver-skinned people of the marsh, all dead of the Knahaten Flu long ago), and the Chime-Keepers of Toklea keep what is left of Kothringi lore. She already knew the Unbound had not found the wreck, and did not say how. She paid me 100 gold.

plan.going: The keystone is Kothringi; the Chime-Keepers of Toklea may know what it opens. Nesh-Deeka again knew where the Unbound had or had not been. The hunt's aim: find the Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel that can heal every tree, at the Root, where all the trees' roots meet under the sea, before the Unbound do.
plan.next: MN08 starts; its first entry marks Toklea.
terms: Kothringi: Nesh-Deeka: the silver-skinned people of the marsh, dead of the Knahaten Flu
the Chime-Keepers of Toklea: Nesh-Deeka: the town that keeps Kothringi lore

answers: I brought the keystone to Nesh-Deeka and she paid me 100 gold. She does not know the keystone, but it is Kothringi make. The Kothringi were a silver-skinned marsh people, dead of the Knahaten Flu. She says the Unbound never found the wreck, and I do not know how she knows that.
The quest is done. The lead is to take the keystone to the Chime-Keepers of Toklea, on the river fork in the Tulmek Washes, and ask their elder.
I can go to Toklea, ask Nesh-Deeka more, or look for the other leads.

I do not know what the keystone opens or does, who the Chime-Keepers really are, or how Nesh-Deeka knows what the Unbound have done. Cuts-the-Old-Knot, seal paste, Xeech-Leel and Umbriel are still unknown. I can ask in Toklea.
